errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос представлява категориите наети лица
errors.evidence: The chart is a horizontal bar chart, meaning the categories of hired persons are listed on the vertical axis, not the horizontal one.

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос представлява оценката за уязвимост, обозначена като процент
errors.evidence: In this horizontal bar chart, the percentage values are represented along the horizontal axis, not the vertical axis.

errors.text_span: Всяка категория е представена от три стълба
errors.evidence: Each category is represented by a single horizontal stacked bar composed of four segments, not three separate bars (stumps).
The legend and chart show four categories of vulnerability. The description omits the category "В много малка степен" (To a very small extent).

The value of 0.8% for the long-term unemployed corresponds to the category "Изобщо не са уязвими" (Not vulnerable at all), not "до голяма степен" (To a large extent). The lowest value for "до голяма степен" is 23.0% for mothers with children up to 14 years of age.

errors.text_span: Най-високият отчетен процент за "изобщо не са уязвими" е 31,7% за лицата с увреждания.
errors.evidence: The value of 31.7% for persons with disabilities corresponds to the category "В много малка степен" (To a very small extent), which was omitted from the description. The highest value for "изобщо не са уязвими" (Not vulnerable at all) is actually 5.6%, also for persons with disabilities.
The percentage axis is implicit and has no visible tick marks or labels indicating intervals of 10.
